# A.N.J.distribution, s.r.o. - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: A.N.J.distribution, s.r.o. (private limited company).  
- Headquarters: Murgasova 738/27, 927 01 Šaľa, Slovakia.  
- Years in operation: Founded in 2024 (young, rapidly expanding company).  
- Core business focus: Production and international distribution of protein‑enhanced snacks, food supplements and “free‑from” grocery products; private label development and retail channel distribution.  
- Trade show presence: Exhibitor (Gulfood 2026) — North Hall 13, Stand DG‑E45.

## Sector Expertise

### Grocery Trade
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Protein‑enhanced snacks and bars, collagen + fiber snacks, protein powders and shakes, food supplements, functional snacks (low sugar, gluten‑free, lactose‑free), dietary and sports nutrition items.
  - Private label and contract manufacturing for grocery retailers focusing on health, performance and “clean” ingredients.
- Production capacity, trade volume or scale of operations:
  - Operates in-house production for protein‑based products and has manufacturing partnerships to support retail volumes. Active distribution into international grocery channels across 38 countries.
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Production sites operate under HACCP and IFS standards. Additional certifications such as KOSHER and HALAL are available on request to meet retailer or market requirements.
- Geographic reach and retail markets:
  - Distribution network covering 38 countries with a strategic focus on placing Slovak producer brands on global grocery shelves. Active presence at major international trade fairs to secure retail partnerships.
- Key differentiators or specializations:
  - Dual role as producer and distributor enabling quick route‑to‑shelf for new products.
  - Expertise in protein‑enriched, “free‑from” and functional snack formats tailored for health‑conscious consumers.
  - Flexible private label and low‑quantity production options that reduce retailer risk when trialing new SKUs.

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Gam’s brand: protein‑enhanced snacks (collagen + fiber formulations), performance snacks and food supplements for stamina and recovery.
  - Protein bars and snacks (Space Protein range distribution), tiger‑nut based snacks and bars, nut creams, granolas and porridges.
  - Functional beverages and powders (protein shakes), dietary products, gluten‑free and sugar‑free snack lines.
  - Complementary grocery items distributed from partner brands (Dobre časy, Martin’s Cider, Powerlogy, Tiger Nuts).
- Product categories and ranges:
  - Sports nutrition (bars, shakes, powders), protein snacks (baked/soft bars, collagen bites), free‑from foods (gluten‑free, lactose‑free, sugar‑free), natural ciders and specialty beverages.
- Key product lines:
  - Gam’s protein snack line, Space Protein bars, tiger‑nut products, selected partner brands for grocery retail.
- Packaging and distribution methods:
  - Retail‑ready packaging for supermarkets and convenience stores (single‑serve, multipacks), private label packaging solutions, and ability to produce small pilot runs for market testing. Distribution via direct retail partnerships, regional distributors and e‑commerce channels.

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Hybrid producer‑distributor: manufactures proprietary products (Gam’s) and acts as distributor/agent for other Slovak brands into international grocery channels.
- Production facilities and operational capability:
  - Own production lines for protein snacks and supplements; partnerships with certified co‑packers to scale volumes or meet specific certification needs.
- Supply chain and logistics:
  - Centralized coordination from Šaľa with partnerships for regional logistics, enabling consolidated shipments to retailers and distributors across multiple countries. Focus on reliable cold‑chain or ambient handling as product requirements dictate.
- Trade and export capabilities:
  - Established export operations into 38 countries, experience with international retail listing requirements, documentation and certification compliance for cross‑border grocery trade.

## Quality and Certifications
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - HACCP and IFS certified production sites. Ability to supply Kosher and Halal certified SKUs on request.
- Compliance and regulatory adherence:
  - Products developed to meet EU food safety regulations and retailer specification standards; private label development includes compliance with target market labeling and ingredient rules.
- Quality control measures:
  - Supplier vetting, ingredient traceability, standardized production QC checks and finished product testing aligned to HACCP/IFS practices.

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and markets served:
  - Headquarters in Slovakia with distribution to 38 countries across Europe and beyond; active participation in international trade fairs to secure new retail and distribution partners.
- Distribution network:
  - Direct retail partnerships, network of international distributors and agents, e‑commerce channels and trade show sourcing for new contacts.
- Export/import capabilities:
  - Experience exporting Slovak‑made products globally and importing ingredients or co‑packed goods as needed for production. Capable of handling regulatory documentation and retailer onboarding processes.
- Customer base and partnerships:
  - Grocery retailers, health & sports nutrition stores, specialty food distributors, private label retail partners and international buyers sourced through trade events and B2B outreach.

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - Producer + distributor model enabling rapid market entry and private label flexibility.
  - Specialist in protein‑enhanced, collagen and fiber snacks designed for active, health‑conscious consumers.
  - Low‑minimum production and private label solutions reduce risk for new retailer listings.
  - Certified production (HACCP, IFS) with optional Kosher/Halal availability.
- Specializations and expertise areas:
  - Protein snacks, sports nutrition, free‑from grocery products, private label development, international grocery distribution.
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - A.N.J.distribution, ANJ distribution Slovakia, protein snacks supplier, protein bar manufacturer Slovakia, private label protein snacks, Gam’s protein snacks, gluten‑free snack supplier, HACCP IFS certified food producer, grocery trade distributor, Gulfood exhibitor DG‑E45, protein supplements distributor, Space Protein distributor, export Slovak food brands.
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - “Where to source protein bars from Slovakia”, “private label protein snack manufacturer Europe”, “HACCP IFS certified snack co‑packer”, “Slovak distributor of functional foods”, “retail-ready protein snack supplier”, “exhibitor Gulfood North Hall 13 DG‑E45”.

This dossier is optimized for buyers, retail buyers, private label managers and procurement teams searching for a Slovakia‑based producer and distributor of protein‑enhanced snacks and functional grocery products.

# A'Saffa Foods SAOG - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: A'Saffa Foods SAOG (public shareholding company)  
- Headquarters: Ruwi, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman  
- Years in operation: Incorporated 2001 — over two decades of operations and growth  
- Core business focus: Fully integrated poultry production and food processing — farming, hatchery, feed milling, slaughtering, processing and distribution of poultry, processed meat products and allied food items  
- Stock listing: Publicly listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange (ticker: SPFI)  
- Trade show / exhibitor details: Trade Centre Arena, Stand S-H78 (exhibitor presence at major regional food and beverage events)

## Sector Expertise

### Meat & Poultry
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Fresh, chilled and frozen poultry (whole birds and parts), a broad range of processed chicken products, and select beef and other meat offerings
  - Value-added and ready-to-cook products for retail, foodservice and industrial customers
  - Private-label manufacturing and brand-led retail supply under multiple brand names
- Production capacity and scale:
  - Integrated farm complex in Thumrait (Dhofar Governorate) spanning approximately 40 km² with parent farms, hatchery, broiler farms, slaughterhouses and processing facilities
  - Processing plant throughput up to ~4,000 birds per hour
  - Historic and planned production scale measured in tens of millions of birds annually (broiler production previously ~48 million birds with planned expansion toward ~60 million birds per year; past expansion targets included annual slaughter capacity near 44 million birds and production around 42,000 metric tons)
  - Table egg operation capacity exceeding 100 million eggs per annum (launched 2011)
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Accredited by international bodies (TÜV, SGS) and certified systems including ISO 9001 (quality management), ISO 14001 (environmental management) and HACCP (food safety)
  - Committed to stringent halal practices — “Real Halal” program involving manual hand-slaughtering by Muslim workers per Islamic Sharia without electrical stunning
  - Adopts Good Manufacturing and food hygiene practices aligned with global food safety expectations
- Geographic reach and export markets:
  - Dominant market leader in Oman with an estimated market share near 35% in poultry
  - Export markets encompass GCC and wider international markets including UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Iraq, Lebanon, Egypt, Vietnam, China and Pakistan
- Key differentiators or specializations:
  - Largest fully integrated poultry project in Oman providing end-to-end control from feed and breeding to processing and distribution
  - “Real Halal” certification and manual slaughter practices as a distinguishing quality claim
  - Strong vertical integration enabling traceability, consistent supply and food security contributions to Oman
  - Diverse product portfolio tailored for retail, foodservice and industrial channels

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Poultry: Fresh and frozen whole chickens; parts including breast, thigh, drumstick, wings, fillet, gizzard and liver
  - Processed chicken products: Breaded and plain burgers, chicken mince, frankfurters, nuggets, fingers, meatballs, seekh kebabs, shish taouk
  - Beef and other meats: Beef burgers, beef mince, tender beef cubes, beef meatballs, mortadella
  - Diversified food lines: Frozen vegetables, seafood, fruit pulps, bottled natural and mineral water
  - Table eggs: Commercial egg production for retail and foodservice
- Product categories and packaging:
  - Fresh/chilled lines, frozen bulk and consumer packs, ready-to-cook and value-added processed SKUs
  - Retail-ready packaging, bulk frozen palletized shipments for export, and branded/private-label packaging options
- Key product lines and brands:
  - Primary brands: A'Saffa, Khayrat, Taybat, Al YaQeen
  - Private label and contract manufacturing services for retailers and foodservice operators

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Fully integrated manufacturer and food processor with in-house breeding, feed milling, hatchery operations, broiler farming, slaughtering and processing; combined with direct distribution and logistics
  - Revenue mix from domestic retail, foodservice, institutional supply and export sales
- Production facilities and operational footprint:
  - Major integrated complex in Thumrait (Dhofar) and processing/manufacturing facilities in Muscat
  - Dedicated feed mill, hatchery, parent stock farms and modern slaughter and processing lines
  - Distribution and logistics arm (A'Saffa Logistics LLC) for warehousing, cold chain and national distribution
- Supply chain and logistics capabilities:
  - Vertical integration ensures control of feed inputs, farming protocols, animal health and processing traceability
  - Cold chain infrastructure and coordinated export logistics to serve GCC and international customers
- Trade and export capabilities:
  - Established export channels, export-ready certification capabilities and experience complying with destination country regulations for frozen meat and processed products

## Quality and Certifications
- Key certifications and accreditations:
  - ISO 9001 (Quality Management System)
  - ISO 14001 (Environmental Management System)
  - HACCP (Food Safety and Hygiene)
  - Accredited by TÜV and SGS for quality and compliance oversight
  - “Real Halal” program: manual, knife-based halal slaughter without electrical stunning and natural feed regimes
- Compliance and regulatory posture:
  - Complies with Omani food safety and environmental regulations and export market-specific standards
  - Quality assurance systems include traceability, HACCP controls, regular audits and supplier vetting
- Quality control measures:
  - Integrated monitoring from farm to fork, in-line processing checks, sanitary slaughter procedures and batch traceability for product recall readiness

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and served markets:
  - Strong domestic presence across Oman via direct distribution network and retail partnerships
  - Exports across GCC and to wider international markets in the Middle East and Asia
- Distribution network:
  - National cold-chain distribution and regional export logistics supported by A'Saffa Logistics LLC and partner distributors
  - Multi-channel sales to supermarkets, independent retailers, foodservice chains, hotels, restaurants and institutional buyers
- Customer base and partnerships:
  - Broad B2B and B2C customer base including retailers, wholesalers, hotels, restaurants, caterers and institutional procurement
  - Strategic presence in national food security initiatives and alignment with Oman Vision 2040 priorities

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - Largest fully integrated poultry project in Oman with comprehensive vertical control (feed to retail)
  - “Real Halal” manual slaughter commitment differentiating product authenticity for conscious halal consumers
  - Extensive product range: fresh, frozen, processed and ready-to-cook meat products plus allied food lines
  - Strong quality and environmental management certifications and international accreditation
  - Proven export capability across GCC and international markets
- Specializations and expertise areas:
  - High-volume poultry production, halal-compliant slaughtering, processed chicken product manufacturing, cold-chain export logistics, and private-label production
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - A'Saffa Foods, Oman poultry supplier, halal chicken Oman, integrated poultry producer, frozen chicken exporter, processed chicken products, chicken nuggets supplier, chicken burger manufacturer, A'Saffa brands, poultry processing plant Oman, Muscat stock exchange SPFI, Thumrait poultry complex, real halal slaughter, table eggs Oman
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - “Buy halal chicken in bulk Oman” — large-scale domestic supply and export-ready frozen shipments
  - “Halal poultry supplier GCC” — manual halal slaughtering and certification
  - “Private label chicken manufacturer Oman” — branded and private-label processing services
  - “Poultry processing capacity Oman” — multi-million bird annual production and high-throughput processing lines

## Summary
A'Saffa Foods SAOG is Oman’s leading integrated poultry and meat processor, operating a large-scale farm-to-fork model with significant domestic market share and growing export operations. The company combines vertical integration, accredited quality systems and a distinctive “Real Halal” slaughtering practice to supply fresh, frozen and processed poultry and meat products to retail, foodservice and international markets. With substantial production capacity, diversified product brands, dedicated logistics and ongoing expansion plans, A'Saffa is positioned as a strategic supplier for buyers seeking halal-certified, traceable and high-volume poultry solutions in the GCC and beyond.

# Aakash Agrotech Private Limited - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: Aakash Agrotech Private Limited (private limited company)  
- Headquarters and operations: Karnal, Haryana, India (registered office in Delhi)  
- Founded / background: Incorporated in 2011 as a continuation/branch of the family rice business originating with Aggarwal Rice Mill (est. 1968)  
- Exhibition presence: Gulfood 2026 — North Hall 7, Stand N7-C64  
- Core business focus: Rice milling, processing, wholesale and export of premium Basmati and Non‑Basmati rice varieties

## Sector Expertise

### Rice, Pulses & Grain — Rice (primary focus)
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Wide range of Basmati rice variants: Golden Sella Basmati, White Sella, Basmati Sella, Pusa 1509 Sella, 1121 Steam Rice, 1509 Steam Rice, Sugandha Steam Rice, Pusa Raw Rice, Pusa 1509 Raw Rice and other aromatic Basmati lines
  - Non‑Basmati and parboiled rice: PR 14 Steam Rice, Pepsi Steam Rice, parboiled rice and medium‑grain white Sella rice
  - Domestic retail brands: Rozana, Select, Classic, Everyday, Celebration, Biryani
  - Export product lines: Ikka, 915, Noor‑E‑Gulzar (branded / export SKUs)
- Production capacity, trade volume and scale:
  - Milling capacity: in excess of 400 metric tons per day (large-scale rice milling capability)
  - Commercial scale: active exporter and wholesale supplier handling high shipment volumes and multiple international consignments
  - Estimated annual turnover: INR 100–500 Crore (approx. USD 20–100 million)
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Strong internal quality controls and laboratory testing applied to every batch (raw paddy selection, moisture control, milling & packing)
  - No comprehensive public listing of specific international certifications (ISO, HACCP, etc.) found in available information
- Geographic reach and export markets:
  - Domestic distribution across India via retail and bulk channels
  - Active export operations to international markets (specific destination countries and volumes not publicly disclosed)
- Key differentiators or specializations:
  - Deep legacy and technical know‑how inherited from Aggarwal Rice Mill (since 1968)
  - Large milling throughput (>400 MT/day) enabling bulk, commercial and export orders
  - Broad Basmati portfolio including large‑grain 1121 and Pusa 1509 series, plus branded retail and export SKUs
  - End‑to‑end rice processing capabilities (parboiling, steam and raw rice lines)

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Basmati Rice: Golden Sella, White Sella, Basmati Sella, Pusa 1509 Sella, 1121 Steam, 1509 Steam, Sugandha Steam, Pusa Raw, Pusa 1509 Raw
  - Non‑Basmati / Parboiled: PR 14 Steam, Pepsi Steam, parboiled rice, medium grain white Sella
  - Retail brands & SKUs: Rozana, Select, Classic, Everyday, Celebration, Biryani
  - Export brands/SKUs: Ikka, 915, Noor‑E‑Gulzar
- Product categories and ranges:
  - Bulk rice for industrial buyers, wholesalers and foodservice
  - Retail‑packed rice under company brands for domestic market
  - Export packing and branded export SKUs for international buyers
- Key product lines:
  - High‑value aromatic Basmati (1121, Pusa 1509 series)
  - Parboiled and steam‑processed rice for foodservice and industrial use
- Packaging and distribution methods:
  - Bulk containerized shipments for export (full container loads)
  - Retail packing for domestic brands and distributor orders (specific bag sizes, packaging materials and private‑label services not publicly detailed)

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Rice miller and processor with wholesale and direct export operations; acts as manufacturer, packer and exporter rather than a pure trading-only intermediary
- Production facilities and operational capacity:
  - Milling and processing unit located in Karnal, Haryana with multiple processing lines (parboiling, steam, raw milling)
  - Significant daily throughput (400+ MT/day) supports large commercial orders
- Supply chain and logistics capabilities:
  - Sourcing: direct procurement of paddy from APMC mandis and local growers
  - Quality & processing: batch lab testing, controlled drying to optimal moisture, husking, milling, parboiling/steaming lines, hygienic packing and magnetic tank packing for final product
  - Logistics: containerized export capability and domestic distribution channels (logistics partners and freight arrangements for shipments)
- Trade and export capabilities:
  - Experienced exporter with multiple international consignments; capacity to fulfill bulk export orders and branded SKU shipments

## Quality and Certifications
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Company emphasizes rigorous in‑house quality checks and laboratory testing across processing stages
  - No definitive public record of corporate-level third‑party certifications (e.g., ISO 22000, HACCP, FSSAI compliance specifics) available in the provided data
- Compliance and regulatory information:
  - Operates within Indian food regulatory frameworks and export compliance procedures (FSSAI registration, export documentation typically applicable though not explicitly listed)
- Quality control measures:
  - Raw material selection from regulated mandis, moisture control via drying systems, batch laboratory testing, hygienic milling and packing processes with magnetic tanks to ensure product purity

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and markets served:
  - Operational base in Karnal (Haryana) with registered office in Delhi; serves domestic Indian market and multiple overseas buyers via exports
- Distribution network:
  - Domestic retail presence via company brands, wholesale distribution channels and foodservice sales
  - Export distribution through containerized shipments to overseas distributors and buyers (detailed country list not specified)
- Customer base and partnerships:
  - Food processors, wholesalers, exporters, retailers, and international rice buyers seeking Basmati and parboiled rice

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - High‑capacity mill (400+ MT/day) able to service large export and domestic orders
  - Extensive Basmati rice portfolio including 1121 and Pusa 1509 series and Sella/Steam/Rough variants
  - Legacy expertise via connection to Aggarwal Rice Mill (since 1968) combined with modern processing facilities
  - Integrated quality workflow from paddy procurement to laboratory testing and hygienic packing
- Specializations and expertise areas:
  - Basmati rice milling and export, parboiled/steam rice processing, branded retail SKUs and bulk export supply
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Aakash Agrotech, Indian rice exporter, Basmati rice supplier India, 1121 basmati exporter, Pusa 1509 rice, parboiled rice supplier, Karnal rice mill, bulk rice exporter, Sella rice manufacturer, steam rice exporter, rice mill 400 MT/day, Gulfood exhibitor N7‑C64
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - Sourcing large volumes of premium Basmati rice (1121, Pusa 1509)
  - Procuring parboiled or steam‑processed rice for industrial/foodservice needs
  - Finding an Indian rice miller capable of containerized export and branded SKU supply
  - Evaluating rice suppliers with strong laboratory QC and milling capacity

## Gaps and Missing Public Information
- Exact third‑party certifications (ISO, HACCP, FSSAI registration details) were not publicly disclosed in the available material
- Detailed annual production and export tonnage by SKU and country‑by‑country export destinations are not specified
- Specific packaging sizes, minimum order quantities (MOQs) for export or private‑label capabilities are not listed
- Precise company founding date for the current corporate entity beyond 2011 and full corporate ownership structure not detailed

## Summary
Aakash Agrotech Private Limited is an established Indian rice miller and exporter headquartered in Karnal, Haryana, with roots tracing back to the Aggarwal Rice Mill legacy. The company specializes in a broad portfolio of premium Basmati and Non‑Basmati rice—covering Sella, steam and raw formats including 1121 and Pusa 1509 varieties—backed by a high milling capacity (over 400 MT/day) and significant commercial throughput. Aakash Agrotech serves domestic retail markets with branded SKUs and meets export demand through bulk containerized shipments. Key strengths are its processing scale, deep sector know‑how, and rigorous in‑house quality controls—making it a suited partner for buyers seeking Indian Basmati and parboiled rice at commercial scale.

# Agencia Argentina de Inversiones y Comercio Internacional (AAICI) - Company Dossier

## Company Overview

- Headquarters: Argentina (national offices with diplomatic and commercial representation via embassies/consulates)  
- Mandate: Attract foreign direct investment (FDI) into Argentina and promote the internationalization and export growth of Argentine companies and products  
- Reporting / affiliation: Operates under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Trade and Worship (national government)  
- Sector focus at event: World Food — broad agro‑industry and food export promotion  
- Trade show / exhibitor details: South Hall 4 and multiple stands across the event (26-80, 26-40, N7-F40, N8-A40, N7-F2, N8-A2, Z5-F4, M-B70, TP-101) — large multi‑stand presence indicating cross‑sector delegation and exporters’ showcase

## Sector Expertise

### World Food — Argentine Food & Agro‑Industry Promotion
- Role and services:
  - Country‑level promotion of Argentine food and agricultural exports across commodities, processed foods and specialty/gourmet lines
  - Sector matchmaking connecting Argentine producers with international buyers, distributors, importers, retailers and foodservice chains
  - Support to exporters in meeting market requirements, certifications and sanitary controls
- Priority product categories promoted:
  - Beef (fresh/chilled/frozen), lamb, poultry and other meats
  - Grains & oilseeds: soybeans, corn, wheat, sunflower products
  - Dairy: milk, cheese, dulce de leche and value‑added dairy products
  - Wine and viticulture products (notably Malbec and other varietals)
  - Fruits & vegetables (citrus, apples, pears, blueberries, garlic, onion)
  - Seafood: hake, shrimp, squid and processed fishery products
  - Honey, olive oil and gourmet/processed foods (pasta, confectionery, preserves)
- Scale and market importance:
  - Argentina is a major global food supplier (notably among the leading global exporters in beef, soy and corn), and AAICI leverages that national capacity to develop export routes and bilateral trade opportunities
- Quality and market entry support:
  - Coordinates with national sanitary authority (SENASA) and industry bodies to ensure exporters meet international sanitary, phytosanitary, and food‑safety requirements
  - Facilitates access to international certifications (HACCP, ISO, organic, halal, kosher) and assists companies with documentation and compliance required by importing markets

## Products and Services (Agency Activities)
- Export promotion & market access:
  - Organises and funds official country pavilions at major global food trade fairs and buyer missions
  - Facilitates business matchmaking, B2B meetings and trade missions for Argentine exporters
- Investment attraction:
  - Identifies agro‑industrial investment opportunities and promotes FDI into processing, logistics, cold chain and value‑added food sectors
  - Prepares investment proposals, incentive guidance and bilateral facilitation for investors
- Market intelligence & trade facilitation:
  - Provides market reports, trade statistics, regulatory guidance and importer intelligence to Argentine exporters and foreign buyers
  - Supports navigation of tariffs, non‑tariff barriers and sanitary requirements
- Capacity building & export readiness:
  - Training and advisory services for SMEs on export packaging, labelling, certification, traceability and quality systems
  - Vendor and producer support to scale production for export volumes
- Networking & partnerships:
  - Connects Argentine chambers, producer associations, export consortia and private exporters with foreign distributors, retail buyers and trade partners
  - Coordinates joint promotion campaigns under the “Marca País Argentina” (Country Brand) platform

## Business Model and Operations
- Organizational model:
  - Non‑commercial public agency focused on facilitation, promotion and coordination rather than direct selling of goods
  - Funded and staffed to provide advisory, promotional and market‑opening services to exporters and investors
- Operational approach:
  - Works collaboratively with national ministries, provincial authorities, SENASA and industry chambers to create export campaigns and solve market access barriers
  - Runs trade programmes, exhibition pavilions, buyer missions and targeted sector campaigns to link supply with demand
- Geographic outreach:
  - Global trade engagement through embassies, consulates and representation offices; targeted presence in priority markets including Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East and neighboring Latin American countries

## Quality and Certifications Support
- Regulatory coordination:
  - Liaises with SENASA and other national regulators to ensure Argentine exports meet importing country sanitary and phytosanitary requirements
- Certification facilitation:
  - Helps exporters obtain or verify needed certifications (HACCP, ISO, organic, halal, kosher) and provides guidance on certification pathways
- Traceability and quality assurance:
  - Promotes adoption of traceability systems, sustainable production practices and quality management among exporters to align with global buyer expectations

## Market Presence
- Markets and reach:
  - Global outreach covering Europe, Asia, North America, Middle East, Africa and Latin America
  - Strategic support for market entry and scaling into priority importers of Argentine food commodities and branded products
- Customer base and stakeholders:
  - Argentine exporters (large producers, processors, SMEs), foreign importers, retail and foodservice buyers, investors, trade associations and certification bodies
- Distribution & facilitation network:
  - Supported by diplomatic network and export promotion specialists; organises national pavilions and sector stands to present multiple Argentine suppliers under one coordinated programme

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - Official national trade & investment agency for Argentina — single entry point for exporters and investors seeking Argentine food suppliers or agro‑industry opportunities
  - Broad country portfolio spanning commodities, value‑added foods, wines and specialty gourmet products
  - Practical market access support including sanitary assistance, certification guidance and trade mission coordination
  - Strong alignment with national brand “Marca País Argentina” to leverage origin reputation in quality food exports
- Specializations and expertise:
  - Beef and livestock exports, grains & oilseeds trade promotion, wine export promotion, cold‑chain and export readiness for perishables
  - Investment promotion in agro‑industry, food processing and logistics infrastructure
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Argentina trade agency, AAICI, Argentine export promotion, import Argentine beef, buy Argentine wine, Argentina food exporters, invest in Argentina agroindustry, SENASA export requirements, Argentine grains exporters, Argentina food trade missions, Marca País Argentina, Argentine food suppliers directory, HACCP Argentina exporters, Halal Argentine beef
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - “How to import Argentine beef” — guidance on supplier discovery, sanitary standards and export documentation
  - “Invest in Argentina food processing” — investor facilitation, incentives and project matchmaking for agro‑industry
  - “Find Argentine wine exporters” — curated lists and buyer introductions for Argentine wineries
  - “Export readiness support Argentina” — SME training, certification pathway assistance and market intelligence

## Summary
The Agencia Argentina de Inversiones y Comercio Internacional (AAICI) is Argentina’s national trade and investment promotion agency with a comprehensive mandate to boost Argentine exports and attract foreign investment in strategic sectors, notably the agro‑industrial and food sectors. As the official facilitator, AAICI coordinates market promotion, trade missions, buyer matchmaking, regulatory and certification support, and investment facilitation. Its multi‑stand presence at international food events reflects a wide‑ranging effort to showcase Argentina’s deep food export capability—from beef, grains, dairy and wine to fruits, honey and gourmet processed foods—and to link Argentine producers with global buyers and investors.

# AKANLAR CIKOLATA ICECEK GIDA SAN VE NAK TIC LTD STI - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: AKANLAR CIKOLATA ICECEK GIDA SAN VE NAK TIC LTD STI (trading as Akanlar Chocolate & Drink Co. / Akanlar Gıda)  
- Headquarters & manufacturing base: Gaziantep, Türkiye  
- Founded: 1978 (expanded into foreign trade 1992; manufacturing from 2002)  
- Exhibition presence: Regular exhibitor at international trade fairs (Gulfood, ISM Middle East)  
- Core business focus: Manufacture, branding and export of confectionery, hot & instant powdered beverages, coffee products, chocolate and related food seasonings

## Sector Expertise

### Beverages
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Instant hot beverage formats: 3‑in‑1 and 2‑in‑1 coffee mixes, instant coffee, cappuccino, latte, hot chocolate, sahlep, milk tea
  - Instant cold / powdered drinks: fruit‑flavoured powdered drinks and powdered drink mixes (marketed under "Fresh Quick" and related brands)
  - Coffee creamers and complementary beverage ingredients
  - Beverage-related product development for retail and export markets
- Production capacity / scale:
  - Longstanding manufacturing operations since 2002 with export activity spanning dozens of markets (company records indicate dozens of export consignments; historical exports noted as 157 shipments to 21 buyers in some trade data)
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Company maintains a certificates page and is listed on Halal manufacturer directories — Halal certification is in place for relevant product lines
  - Company emphasizes hygienic production and continuous quality improvement; additional specific certificate details are not publicly enumerated here
- Geographic reach and export markets:
  - Exports to 35–40+ countries across the Middle East, Africa and other regions; established trade links in Dubai, Iraq, USA and multiple MENA markets
- Key differentiators / specializations:
  - Broad instant beverage portfolio (hot and powdered cold drinks) tailored for retail and export markets
  - Multi‑brand strategy with numerous in‑house brands (e.g., Hot Drops, Fresh Quick) and diversified product lines across beverages and confectionery

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Hot beverages: 3‑in‑1 and 2‑in‑1 coffee mixes, instant coffee, cappuccino, latte, hot chocolate, sahlep, milk tea
  - Cold/instant powdered drinks: fruit‑flavoured powdered drink mixes
  - Coffee creamers and beverage adjuncts
  - Confectionery & chocolate: wafers, chocolate bars, pralines, chocolate spreads (Akella Cocoa‑Hazelnut / Ammar Spread), freeze‑dried chocolates, coated dried fruits
  - Snacks & bakery lines: wafers and related confectionery items
  - Food seasonings: bouillons (chicken, beef, vegetable)
  - Other: ice‑cream powder and beverage ingredient lines
- Product brands:
  - Valse, Hot Drops, Ammar, Fresh Quick, Fullbar, Akella, Amasi, Rubix, Akanlar Simo, Birshey, Golden Fruit, Joahr, Melike, Mexi, VivaJus, X‑5 (portfolio across drinks, chocolate and snack categories)
- Packaging and distribution methods:
  - Retail‑ready packs for supermarkets and convenience channels, multipacks and cartons for export, and bulk/commercial packs for foodservice and distributors
  - Exported containerized shipments and regional distribution through partner networks

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Integrated manufacturer, brand owner and exporter — combines R&D/product development, in‑house production and international sales
  - Focus on growing production capacity and expanding export footprint through trade shows and distributor partnerships
- Manufacturing & production:
  - Production facilities located in Gaziantep with lines for powdered drinks, coffee mixes, wafers and chocolate confections; emphasis on automated, hygienic processing
- Supply chain & logistics:
  - Global sourcing of raw materials, consolidating production in Türkiye and shipping to regional partners and distributors
  - Established export routes to MENA, Africa and other international customers
- Sales channels:
  - Retail (modern trade and independent grocers), foodservice, distributors and export partners

## Quality and Certifications
- Stated quality posture:
  - Public materials indicate an ongoing focus on product safety, hygienic manufacturing and continuous improvement
- Known certifications:
  - Halal certification for applicable products (company listed on Halal manufacturer directories)
  - Company references an “Our Certificates” page — additional certificates are implied though not itemized in available summaries
- Quality control measures:
  - Product development and manufacturing under hygiene controls, batch testing and adherence to buyer specifications for export markets
  - Participation in international food trade events suggests compliance with buyer audit expectations

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and markets served:
  - Based in Türkiye with an export focus on the Middle East and African regions and distribution ties into markets such as Dubai, Iraq and select global destinations (35–40+ countries reported)
- Distribution network:
  - Network of export distributors and regional partners; retail listings in multiple markets via third‑party importers and distributors
- Export footprint and scale indicators:
  - Historical trade activity includes numerous export consignments (e.g., past trade data citing 157 shipments to 21 buyers), reflecting active international trade operations

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - Longstanding Turkish manufacturer (since 1978) with in‑house beverage and confectionery manufacturing capability
  - Wide instant beverage range (3‑in‑1, 2‑in‑1, instant coffee, cappuccino, latte, hot chocolate, sahlep) suited to retail and foodservice export markets
  - Extensive brand portfolio enabling multi‑channel retail and export positioning
  - Halal certified product lines targeting Muslim‑majority markets
- Specializations and expertise areas:
  - Instant beverage formulation and powder drink production
  - Chocolate and confectionery manufacturing (wafers, spreads, bars, coated fruits)
  - Export readiness for MENA and African markets
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Turkish instant coffee manufacturer, 3‑in‑1 coffee supplier Türkiye, powdered drinks exporter, Halal coffee producer Turkey, Gaziantep beverage manufacturer, Akanlar chocolate exporter, wafer and chocolate manufacturer Turkey, Gulfood exhibitor Z4‑110
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - Source private‑label or branded instant beverage mixes and coffee blends from a Turkish manufacturer
  - Find Halal‑certified powdered drink and confectionery suppliers for MENA/Africa distribution
  - Identify manufacturers of chocolate wafers, spreads and coated dried fruits for retail or export

## Gaps and Missing Public Information
- Specific third‑party certifications beyond Halal (e.g., ISO, HACCP, BRC, FSSC) are referenced generically but not publicly itemized here — buyers should request current certification documents
- Exact production capacities (line throughput, plant output per period), annual revenue, employee numbers and detailed export tonnages by SKU are not publicly listed in the summary material
- Details on private‑label/OEM services, minimum order quantities (MOQs), lead times and specific country distribution partners require direct commercial enquiry
- Full, up‑to‑date list of markets and major distributors by country is not provided in the available summary

## Summary
AKANLAR (Akanlar Gıda) is a Gaziantep‑based Turkish manufacturer and exporter with deep experience in powdered beverages, instant coffee mixes, chocolate confectionery and related food seasonings. Operating manufacturing lines since 2002 and trading internationally since 1992, the company sells a large branded portfolio across retail and export channels and holds Halal certification for applicable products. Akanlar targets Middle East and African markets (plus other export territories) and presents itself as a versatile supplier for buyers seeking instant beverage mixes, coffee blends and confectionery from a Turkey‑based manufacturer. For procurement, certification verification, production capacity, MOQs and private‑label options, prospective buyers should contact Akanlar directly for up‑to‑date commercial and technical documentation.

# Al Arjawi - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and entity: Al Arjawi — food trading/export company (Syrian Arab Republic).  
- Trade show presence: Exhibitor at Gulfood 2026 — South Hall 10, Stand 58‑60 (World Food sector).  
- Headquarters & history: Public company details are limited; operates from the Syrian Arab Republic and is active in international food trade and export.  
- Core business focus: Sourcing, processing (where applicable), packaging and export of Syrian and Levantine food products for retail, foodservice and distributor markets.

## Sector Expertise

### World Food (Syrian & Levantine specialties)
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Focus on authentic Syrian and Levantine food items that serve specialty, ethnic and world‑food channels. Typical lines associated with Syrian exporters include preserved fruits and vegetables, traditional sweets, confectionery, nut products and pantry staples.
- Trade role:
  - Acts primarily as an exporter/distributor connecting Syrian-origin foods with regional and international buyers, using the UAE and other regional hubs to access global markets.
- Market focus:
  - Target buyers include ethnic grocery importers, specialty food distributors, Middle Eastern retail chains, HoReCa operators and diaspora communities seeking authentic regional products.

## Products and Services
- Likely product categories (based on regional trade patterns and company sector listing):
  - Olives & Olive Oil: whole olives, table olive preparations and bottled olive oil.  
  - Sweets & Confectionery: traditional Syrian sweets and nut‑based confections.  
  - Jams, Preserves & Pickles: fruit jams (fig, apricot), vegetable preserves and pickled vegetables.  
  - Dried Fruits & Nuts: dried apricots, figs, raisins, almonds, pistachios and mixed nuts.  
  - Tahini & Halva: sesame paste (tahini) and halva (sesame‑based confectionery).  
  - Spices & Herb Blends: Levantine spice blends and dried herbs.  
  - Canned & Processed Foods: tomato paste, canned vegetables and ready preparations typical to Levantine cuisine.  
- Packaging & formats:
  - Export‑oriented retail jars/tins, bulk cartons for distribution, and foodservice/industrial sizes on request. Private label capabilities would typically be offered by exporters in this category; confirm directly with the company.

## Business Model and Operations
- Typical operating model:
  - Sourcing from local Syrian farms and processors, light processing/packaging where required, and export logistics management to serve regional and international buyers.  
- Services offered:
  - Export supply, B2B distribution, trade show representation, product sampling and negotiation of buyer specifications for shelf‑ready packaging and bulk orders.  
- Logistics:
  - Uses regional shipping and re‑export channels (UAE/GCC hubs common) to reach markets in the Middle East, diaspora communities and specialty food importers worldwide.

## Quality and Certifications
- Public certification status:
  - Specific certifications (Halal, HACCP, ISO, organic) are not publicly listed for Al Arjawi.  
- Buyer guidance:
  - Prospective buyers should request:
    - Halal certificates (where required), sanitary/veterinary and phytosanitary export documentation, HACCP/ISO evidence if needed, product test reports (microbiological, heavy metals, pesticide residues), and country‑of‑origin documentation.  
  - Exporters from Syria typically must meet destination market regulatory requirements — confirmation of documentation and third‑party testing is recommended prior to purchase.

## Market Presence
- Geographic reach:
  - Public information limited; exhibiting at Gulfood signals an intention to expand into GCC and broader international markets. Likely target markets include the UAE, GCC, Levant diaspora markets, and specialty importers in Europe and North Africa.  
- Sales channels:
  - Wholesale distributors, ethnic and specialty food importers, supermarkets with Middle Eastern lines, HoReCa and institutional buyers.

## Unique Attributes and Specializations
- Authentic Syrian origin: Offers traditional Levantine products with provenance that appeals to cultural and specialty food markets.  
- Product range aligned with Middle Eastern pantry and specialty needs (olives, tahini, halva, preserved foods and sweets).  
- Presence at major trade fairs (Gulfood) indicates active export orientation and readiness to engage international buyers.

## Key Attributes for Search (SEO & Buyer Match)
- Unique selling points:
  - Syrian specialty foods exporter, Levantine sweets & tahini supplier, authentic regional olive & preserve supplier, Gulfood exhibitor South Hall 10 Stand 58‑60.
- Specializations and expertise:
  - Traditional Syrian confectionery, preserved foods, dried fruit & nut exports, tahini & halva, olive/olive oil trade.
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Al Arjawi Syria, Syrian food exporter, Syrian halva supplier, tahini exporter Syria, Syrian olives and olive oil, Syrian dried fruits supplier, Levantine sweets exporter, world food supplier Syria, Gulfood Al Arjawi, South Hall 10 stand 58‑60.
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - “Where to source Syrian halva and tahini”, “importers of Syrian olives and preserves”, “specialty Levantine food exporter for supermarkets”, “Syrian dried fruit supplier for wholesale”, “Al Arjawi Gulfood contact”.

Notes for buyers: Public company details are limited. Prior to engagement, request up‑to‑date company registration information, product specifications, certification documents, sample shipments and terms of sale (MOQ, pricing, lead times, incoterms, payment and logistics). This dossier is optimized for importers, specialty food distributors, retail buyers and trade visitors seeking authentic Syrian and Levantine food products.

# AL Amin Co. - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: AL Amin Co. (Al Amin Sweets & Food Co.) — food manufacturer & exporter  
- Headquarters: Damascus, Syrian Arab Republic  
- Years in operation: Established origins from 1919 — century‑plus history in traditional Syrian food production  
- Core business focus: Manufacture, packaging and export of traditional Middle Eastern and Syrian food products (confectionery, pastes, syrups, preserves, cooking ingredients and ethnic pantry staples)  
- Trade show / exhibitor details: South Hall 10, Stand 59‑47 (World Food sector)

## Sector Expertise

### World Food — Traditional Middle Eastern & Syrian Foods
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Authentic Syrian confectionery and pantry items designed for ethnic retailers, supermarkets, foodservice and specialty importers
  - B2B supply of retail‑ready packaged goods, bulk foodservice packs and private‑label opportunities
  - Export support for regulated markets (labelling, export documentation, halal compliance)
- Production capacity and scale:
  - Longstanding industrial production capability with modernized facilities able to produce retail volumes and bulk export consignments; capacity supports multi‑market export distribution and trade show representation
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - ISO 22000 food safety management system in place
  - Halal certification for appropriate product lines
  - Internal quality control and hygienic production practices to meet international buyer requirements
- Geographic reach and export markets:
  - Exports to Middle East and North Africa, Europe (markets with Middle Eastern diaspora), North America and other international destinations via distributor and importer networks
- Key differentiators:
  - Heritage brand with authentic Syrian recipes and traditional flavor profiles
  - Full product range covering sweets, spreads, syrups and pantry staples enabling cross‑category shelf presence
  - Certifications and export readiness for faith‑sensitive and regulated markets

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Halawa / Halva (sesame‑based traditional confectionery; varieties: plain, pistachio, chocolate and flavored variants)
  - Tahini (sesame paste) — retail jars and industrial tins
  - Fruit pastes & traditional sweets: Qamar el‑Din (apricot paste), fig paste, date paste
  - Syrups & molasses: date syrup (dibis), grape molasses, carob molasses
  - Jams & marmalades: fig, apricot, quince and assorted fruit preserves
  - Canned & preserved goods: tomato paste, pickles, stuffed grape leaves (dolma) where produced
  - Cooking fats & specialty ingredients: vegetable ghee, traditional shortenings
  - Spices & aromatics: ground spices and flavorings used in Middle Eastern cuisine; floral waters (rose water, orange blossom)
  - Confectionery assortment: Turkish delight (loukoum) and other regional sweets
- Packaging and formats:
  - Retail consumer packs (jars, cans, tubs, vacuum packs), gift boxes and bulk / wholesale cartons for foodservice and importers
  - Custom and bulk packing available to meet retailer or private‑label specifications
- Key product lines and selling propositions:
  - Authentic Syrian taste profiles; long shelf‑stable formats suitable for export; product family that supports cross‑merchandising (sweets, spreads, cooking ingredients)

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Manufacturer and exporter focused on traditional food categories; sells to distributors, ethnic grocery chains, supermarkets, specialty retailers and foodservice importers
  - Offers private label and contract packing arrangements for qualified buyers
- Production & supply chain:
  - Modernized production facilities combining traditional recipes with industrial hygienic processing and batch traceability
  - Sourcing of agricultural raw materials aligned with product authenticity (sesame, dates, fruits)
- Logistics & export capabilities:
  - Experience handling export documentation, sanitary/phytosanitary compliance and halal certification requirements for international shipments
  - Distribution via established importer/distributor networks in target markets and through retail partners

## Quality and Certifications
- Quality systems:
  - ISO 22000 — Food Safety Management System ensuring systematic hazard control across the supply chain
  - Halal certification for products sold to Muslim markets
- Compliance & QA measures:
  - In‑house quality control and laboratory testing for microbiological and chemical safety parameters
  - Batch traceability, hygienic processing lines and documented HACCP‑style controls consistent with export market expectations
- Regulatory readiness:
  - Capable of meeting packaging, labelling and ingredient declaration requirements required by EU, GCC and North American import regulations

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and markets served:
  - Strong domestic presence in Syria; established export reach to the Middle East, North Africa, Europe (diaspora markets) and North America
  - Distribution channels include ethnic food importers, supermarket chains, specialty Middle Eastern stores, wholesalers and foodservice distributors
- Customer base and partnerships:
  - Retailers and supermarket chains targeting Middle Eastern and Mediterranean food categories
  - Ethnic grocery wholesalers, foodservice distributors and specialty importers
  - Potential private‑label partnerships for regional retail chains and distributors

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - Heritage brand with authentic Syrian recipes (since 1919 origins) — trusted provenance for Middle Eastern specialty foods  
  - Widest range of traditional items in one supplier: halawa, tahini, fruit pastes, dibis & grape molasses, preserves, and sweets  
  - ISO 22000 and Halal certified — export-ready for regulated and faith‑sensitive markets  
  - Private‑label and bulk packing capabilities for supermarkets and foodservice buyers
- Specializations and expertise:
  - Traditional Syrian confectionery & spreads, sesame products (tahini & halawa), fruit paste production, molasses & syrups, preserved goods and ethnic pantry staples
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Syrian halva exporter, tahini supplier Syria, date molasses supplier, Qamar el Din manufacturer, Arabic sweets exporter, Middle Eastern jam and preserves, halal halalawa, ISO 22000 Syrian food, buy Syrian tahini wholesale, Al Amin syrups, traditional Syrian food supplier
- Business capabilities matching common search intents:
  - “Buy tahini in bulk” — export packing and wholesale supply available  
  - “Find halal halva exporter” — halal‑certified confectionery suitable for Muslim markets  
  - “Source Middle Eastern fruit paste/Qamar el Din” — retail and bulk formats for importers and food processors  
  - “Private label Middle Eastern sweets” — contract packing and branding for retailers

## Summary
AL Amin Co. is a century‑rooted Syrian food manufacturer specializing in authentic Middle Eastern and Syrian foods—halawa, tahini, fruit pastes, molasses, preserves, sweets and pantry staples—produced with modern hygienic processes and exported worldwide. With ISO 22000 and Halal certifications, in‑house quality controls and private‑label capabilities, AL Amin serves ethnic retailers, importers, supermarkets and foodservice buyers seeking genuine Syrian flavors and export‑compliant product ranges. The company's deep heritage, diverse SKU assortment and export readiness position it as a trusted supplier for global markets targeting Middle Eastern cuisine.

# Akbar Brothers Ltd - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Legal name: Akbar Brothers (Pvt) Ltd  
- Legal entity type: Private limited company (family‑owned corporate group)  
- Headquarters: Colombo, Sri Lanka  
- Founded: Company origins in 1969 with family tea trading legacy dating to 1864  
- Core business focus: Production, branding and global export of high‑quality Ceylon tea and value‑added tea products; private‑label services and diversified investments in allied sectors

## Sector Expertise

### Beverages (Tea — Ceylon Tea Specialist)
- Products and services in this sector:
  - Full spectrum of Ceylon tea offerings: black tea, green tea, white tea, flavored teas, herbal infusions, iced tea and premium gift collections
  - Branded consumer products (Akbar Tea, Alghazaleen Tea, VERDE Tea) and private‑label / co‑packing for retailers and HORECA customers
  - Blending, custom formulation, packing and bulk tea supply for industrial and retail buyers
- Production capacity, trade volume and scale:
  - Market leadership as the world’s largest exporter of single‑origin Ceylon tea with annual export volumes measured in tens of millions of kilograms (historical volumes cited above 50 million kg in major periods)
  - Large integrated manufacturing complex (>276,000 sq ft) supporting high‑volume blending, packing and quality control
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - Robust certification profile across manufacturing and supply chain (ISO 9001, ISO 22000, HACCP among early achievers) and multiple product/sustainability accreditations
- Geographic reach and export markets:
  - Exports to 90–100+ countries across Middle East, Europe, North America, Africa and Asia
  - Strong presence in retail, institutional and duty‑free channels worldwide
- Key differentiators:
  - Deep family stewardship with long lineage in the tea trade and hands‑on quality approval processes
  - Scale and vertical integration from sourcing and blending to advanced packing and global logistics
  - Capability to supply both consumer retail SKUs and large bulk consignments for industrial buyers

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Black Tea: orthodox and CTC variants for retail, blends and tea bags  
  - Green Tea: single‑origin Ceylon green tea lines  
  - White Tea: premium single‑origin white tea  
  - Flavored Teas: fruit and dessert blends (e.g., Fruit Fiesta, Strawberry Cream, Vanilla Twilight, Earl Grey)  
  - Herbal Infusions: caffeine‑free herbal and botanical blends  
  - Iced Tea & Ready‑to‑Serve formulations  
  - Gift Tea Collections and premium boxed assortments  
  - Private label, contract blending and bulk tea supply (merchant and branded packing)
- Product categories and ranges:
  - Tea bags, pyramid sachets, loose leaf, retail pouches, tins, bulk tea in sacks and industrial packaging
- Packaging and distribution methods:
  - Retail packaging (consumer packs, gift tins) and industrial bulk (25–50 kg sacks, lined containers) with cold‑chain and freight solutions as required
  - Private label and bespoke packaging for supermarket chains, duty‑free, and HORECA customers

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Integrated tea merchant and branded tea manufacturer exporting single‑origin Ceylon tea worldwide; combines in‑house sourcing, blending and packing with global distribution networks
  - Revenue mix: branded retail sales, bulk exports, private‑label contracts and institutional supply
- Production facilities and operational capacity:
  - Large modern manufacturing site with automated processing, blending and packing lines using international equipment
  - Capability for high‑volume orders, bespoke blends and multi‑format packaging
- Supply chain and logistics capabilities:
  - Sourcing from Sri Lankan tea regions, centralized blending/QA at Kelaniya facility, and global logistics to 90–100+ destination countries
  - Export documentation, regulatory compliance and retailer audit readiness embedded in processes
- Trade and export capabilities:
  - Extensive export operations servicing retail chains, wholesalers, distributors and foodservice customers; experienced in regulatory and phytosanitary requirements across major markets

## Quality and Certifications
- Corporate/product quality profile:
  - ISO 9001 (Quality Management) and ISO 22000 (Food Safety Management) across operations  
  - HACCP food safety systems in place (one of the earliest Sri Lankan tea companies awarded ISO & HACCP)  
  - IFS / retailer audit readiness and other market‑specific certifications applied per product destination
- Sustainability and environmental credentials:
  - Recognition for environmental management and sustainability programs within the group (including carbon‑management initiatives in group subsidiaries)
  - Traceability and supplier governance to meet retailer and regulatory standards
- Quality control measures:
  - In‑house laboratory testing, certified QA sampling for each consignment, family oversight of quality approvals and third‑party testing where required

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and markets served:
  - Global exporter to 90–100+ countries; strong penetration in Middle East, Europe, North America, Africa and Asia
  - Customer segments: supermarket chains, specialty tea retailers, importers/distributors, HORECA and private‑label partners
- Distribution network:
  - Warehousing and packing hubs in Sri Lanka with international distribution partners and freight/logistics networks to serve global buyers
- Export performance:
  - Sustained multi‑million‑kg export volumes annually establishing long‑term buyer relationships and repeat contracts
- Events and visibility:
  - Regular exhibitor at major global food and beverage fairs to secure retail listings and distribution agreements (e.g., Gulfood — Za’abeel Hall 3, Stand Z3‑B10)

## Key Attributes for Search
- Unique selling points:
  - World’s largest exporter of single‑origin Ceylon tea with deep family legacy in tea trade  
  - Full product range (black, green, white, flavored, herbal, iced) and capacity for private‑label contract packing and bulk supply  
  - Large modern manufacturing & packing facility with strong QA, traceability and export compliance for demanding markets
- Specializations and expertise areas:
  - Ceylon tea sourcing, blending and private‑label packaging; premium tea assortments and custom blends for HORECA and retail
- Relevant keywords and search terms:
  - Akbar Brothers, Akbar Tea, Ceylon tea exporter Sri Lanka, largest Ceylon tea exporter, Akbar Tea private label, Alghazaleen Tea, VERDE Tea, black tea exporter Sri Lanka, green tea supplier, white tea exporter, flavored Ceylon tea, herbal tea exporter, gift tea collection, Kelaniya tea factory, Gulfood exhibitor Z3‑B10
- Business capabilities that match common search intents:
  - Sourcing bulk single‑origin Ceylon tea for industrial or retail needs  
  - Procuring branded or private‑label Ceylon tea SKUs for supermarket chains and specialty stores  
  - Partnering for bespoke tea blends, co‑packing or export supply with full QA and regulatory support

## Notable Leadership & Corporate Attributes
- Family involvement: Multi‑generational family ownership with hands‑on senior management and family quality approvals for consignments  
- Manufacturing scale: Large Kelaniya facility with modern equipment from global suppliers enabling high throughput and diverse product lines  
- Corporate diversification: Group interests beyond tea into energy, packaging, healthcare and environmental services while maintaining tea as core Power Brand

---

This dossier profiles Akbar Brothers Ltd as a globally leading Ceylon tea producer and exporter—highlighting its comprehensive tea product range, private‑label capabilities, manufacturing scale, certifications, sustainability credentials and search‑optimized attributes for buyers, distributors and partners seeking premium Sri Lankan tea.

# AKIJ FOOD AND BEVERAGE LTD - Company Dossier

## Company Overview
- Company name and legal entity: AKIJ FOOD AND BEVERAGE LTD (AFBL) — food & beverage manufacturing unit of Akij Group  
- Headquarters / main factory: Dhaka (head office) / major factory complex in Dhamrai (Krishnapura), Bangladesh  
- Exhibition presence: Gulfood 2026 — Za'abeel Hall 6, Stand Z6‑H60  
- Years in operation / background: Corporate operations began 2006 under the Akij Group legacy (group origins from 1950)  
- Core business focus: Integrated manufacture, packaging, domestic distribution and export of beverages (CSD, juices, energy drinks, bottled water), dairy & milk products and complementary snack lines

## Sector Expertise

### Beverages
- Products and services:
  - Carbonated soft drinks (CSD): Mojo (leading cola brand), Speed (high-volume cola/energy brand), Clemon, Lemu, Wild Brew
  - Fruit juices & aseptic drinks: Frutika (flagship aseptic juice brand), Aafi, DrinkEat
  - Energy drinks: Speed (energy variants), Turbo
  - Bottled water: Spa (packaged drinking water)
  - Dairy & milk-based: fresh milk products (sourced via contract farming), milk‑based beverages and derivative products
  - Other beverage formats: malted drinks, flavored drinks and beverage adjuncts
- Production & processing capability:
  - Large Dhamrai complex (~80 acres) housing multi‑shift production lines
  - High throughput filling capability: up to 80,000 units/hour across CSD and aseptic lines (plant combined capacity across lines)
  - Frutika aseptic line capacity: 54,000 units per hour (250 ml bottles); pulp processing capability cited at ~134,000 liters of pulp every three hours
  - Extensive packaging and bottling equipment sourced from global manufacturers (Krones, Tetra Pak, Alfa Laval, Sipa)
- Quality standards and certifications:
  - National and international compliance: BSTI, HALAL, ISO (includes reference to ISO 9000:2008), HACCP
  - Environmental recognition: Government "Green Factory Award" for sustainability practices
- Market focus and reach:
  - Strong national distribution across Bangladesh with major retail and on‑trade presence
  - Active exporter to international markets (regional focus: South & Southeast Asia, Middle East; specific export markets include Malaysia, India, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Oman, UAE, Maldives, Bhutan)
  - Recorded export turnover of US$8.03 million (Aug 2024 – Jul 2025)

## Products and Services
- Comprehensive product list:
  - Carbonated soft drinks: Mojo, Speed, Clemon, Lemu, Wild Brew
  - Juices & aseptic drinks: Frutika (multiple SKUs), Aafi, DrinkEat
  - Energy drinks: Speed, Turbo
  - Bottled water: Spa
  - Dairy & milk products: fresh milk, processed dairy items sourced via Akij Dairy Plant and contract farming network
  - Snacks & complementary foods: Cheese puffs, potato crackers, Chanchur, Muri, Akij Toast, Dry Cake, Checky Monkey banana chips
  - Ingredients/processing outputs: mango pulp and other fruit pulps from Akij Agro Processing Farm (AAPF)
- Packaging and distribution:
  - PET and aseptic bottle lines, multi‑format retail packs, bulk distribution for institutional customers
  - National distribution network for retail, trade and institutional channels; export via containerized shipments and overseas distributors

## Business Operations
- Business model:
  - Integrated manufacturer‑exporter‑distributor: in‑house production, upstream raw material contracting (contract farming), processing, bottling and multi‑channel distribution
  - Vertical integration into sourcing: Akij Agro Processing Farm (AAPF) for mango pulp and contract farming arrangements for milk and fruit supply
- Manufacturing & technology:
  - State‑of‑the‑art processing and packaging equipment (international OEMs) enabling high‑speed bottling and aseptic packaging
  - Large factory footprint operating multi‑shift to sustain continuous production
- Supply chain & logistics:
  - Domestic distribution network covering modern trade, grocery retail, foodservice and institutional sales
  - Export logistics capability with documented export turnover and presence in multiple international markets

## Quality and Certifications
- Food safety and standards:
  - BSTI (Bangladesh Standards & Testing Institution) registration/standards compliance
  - HALAL certification for applicable SKUs
  - HACCP food safety systems applied across production lines
  - ISO certification presence referenced (including ISO 9000:2008 for quality)
  - Green Factory Award for environmental performance
- Quality control measures:
  - Rigorous production hygiene, aseptic processing for preservative‑free juices, batch testing and supplier controls
  - Certification and audit readiness to support export market requirements

## Market Presence
- Geographic presence and served markets:
  - Domestic: extensive nationwide distribution across Bangladesh
